name: TubeAlfred
description:
TubeAlfred gives Claude read-only access to public YouTube data — with no Google Cloud project, API quota, or OAuth consent screen to configure.

35 tools cover:

• Transcripts — caption text with timestamps, in any available language, manual or auto-generated
• Comments and replies — full threads with author, engagement, timestamp, and pagination fields
• Videos — title, description, keywords, view and like counts, duration, chapters, category, live status, and related videos
• Channels — profile, about, videos, Shorts, live streams, playlists, and community posts
• Playlists — metadata and ordered contents, paginated to any depth
• Search — queries with filters, hashtag results, autocomplete suggestions, and trending listings
• Utilities — resolve any YouTube URL, plus batch lookups for up to 50 videos or channels at once

Typical uses: summarise or quote a video from what is actually said in it; find out what an audience is asking for in the comments; inventory a course or playlist; audit a video's discoverability for a target search; compare how several channels cover the same topic.

Credits are shared across every TubeAlfred surface. Most calls cost 1 credit. Comment retrieval costs 1 credit per 5 comments with a 100-comment minimum, so at least 20 credits per call. New accounts start with 100 free credits, and no card is required.

TubeAlfred is read-only. It cannot publish, edit, like, subscribe, or moderate anything on YouTube.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TubeAlfred to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TubeAlfred to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tubealfred.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TubeAlfred MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TubeAlfred lists 35 MCP tools, including youtube_channel_about, youtube_channel_community, youtube_channel_community_page, youtube_channel_get, youtube_channel_playlists, youtube_channel_playlists_page, youtube_channel_shorts, youtube_channel_shorts_page, youtube_channel_streams, youtube_channel_streams_page, youtube_channel_videos, and youtube_channel_videos_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TubeAlfred?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to TubeAlfred in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
TubeAlfred requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TubeAlfred is developed by TubeAlfred. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
